d:
I hope y'all weren't expecting me to do full SFX for this.
I instead spent all of my personal redraw budget on the cover (Thanks AJubbz for cleaning everything else!) which I honestly still think feels a bit plain for my taste. At the same time, I didn't want to go too crazy and live in my head for a week straight thinking of ways to spice it up.

I did fully plan to only release this when the extras were all uploaded onto his fanbox, but the two were released quite close which worked out well.
